title: Write with AI
description: Choose what you want. Nothing changes until you select Use this.
what: What would you like to do?
request_draft_hint: A few words are enough. For example: the office is closed on Friday for maintenance.
edit_after: Choose Use this, then make any changes in the editor.
needs_text: Enter some text first, or choose Draft.
needs_request: Say what the text should cover.
privacy: The text is sent to your organisation's AI provider. Check the suggestion before you use it.
